title: ManyHats Ledger
description: An AI-powered multi-schedule bookkeeping ledger built for founders, freelancers, and operators who wear many hats.

resonance.gatherer: Organizing multiple community initiatives, side projects, and collaborative ventures into clean, segregated financial buckets.
resonance.craftsman: Precision multi-schedule tax accounting (Schedule C, E, F) and clean exports crafted with zero bloated enterprise fluff.
resonance.explorer: Navigating the messy frontiers of solo business ownership without getting bogged down in legacy accounting software.
resonance.catalyst: Accelerating from shoeboxes of receipts to total financial clarity with instant AI categorization and OCR extraction.
resonance.storykeeper: Preserving a permanent visual vault of every receipt and financial milestone along your venture-building journey.
resonance.architect: Designing clean entity boundaries and custom tax schedule operational structures for multi-venture setups.
